name: Packet
author: Erin Carter
description: A live data bus — rows of byte cells streaming sideways at their own rates, values re-rolling as they pass, bright packet bursts travelling through the dim traffic while a read cursor sweeps the columns. Horizontal data flow, all signal.

params.label: Byte cells
params.effect: How many byte cells span a row; low is chunky data, high a dense bus.

params.label: Stream speed
params.effect: How fast the rows scroll; 0 freezes the data. Each row varies around this.

params.label: Packet density
params.effect: How many bright packet bursts travel through the traffic; 0 is quiet, high is busy.

params.label: Value churn
params.effect: How fast the byte values re-roll; 0 freezes them, high keeps the data changing.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer lights its row; 0 ignores the mouse.
